verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents that every flow starts with a trigger followed by actions, and it connects to 760+ apps, so app-event triggering is the core model. However, the evidence never explicitly shows triggers firing on app events such as new records, messages, emails or form submissions. missing for 10: explicit documentation of event-based app triggers (new record, message, email, form submission), a list of trigger types per piece, independent or hands-on corroboration of triggers firing.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can trigger workflows from events in connected apps (new record, message, email, form submission)

citations.quote: Flow consists of two parts, trigger and actions
Actions come after the trigger and control what occurs when the flow is activated
Move data, send messages and update records between 764 apps without writing glue code.
